newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close higher in continuous trade.

text.p: Five stocks rose, two fell and seven were flat in seven-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Friday with the WIG 20 index up 0.1 percent to 1,559.6 points.
The remaining nine stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 1.1 percent to 139.5 zlotys in a 9.4-million-zloty turnover.
Six National Investment Funds (NFIs) fell, one rose and six were flat in 0.8-million-zloty trade. Two did not trade.
